verdict.rationale: Warp ships automations: cloud agents triggered by events or schedules, and saved Warp Drive workflows. The only part of the story with evidence is review. Every run is tracked, auditable and shareable, and you can open a run transcript to inspect the prompt, plan, commands, logs and output for team review. Missing for 10: versioning of automation or workflow definitions, rollback to prior automation versions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
